_howTo: One entry in 'events' per event, in the order you want them shown. Put the church's poster in the posters/ folder and write its file name in 'poster'. 'tag' (branch or audience), 'title' and 'when' are the words shown on the small homepage card. 'endDate' (YYYY-MM-DD) is the last day of the event: from the next day it disappears from the cards and the pop-up by itself. 'alt' is optional: a short description of the poster for people using screen readers.
